about: Step 6, temp book staging/words.js (Mid's 07-text.js): every line of wording the game says, and the history behind each row. in v100: v100 already shows it (mostly menu.js). bring: comes as entries in a new Words book with its feature. cut: v100 does it another way. The big tables (WHY, MS_TEXT, EV_WHY, EV_TEXT, ROW_WORD, TRIGGERS) carry a line per row; misfits go to Albert.

orList: F11: menu.js, orList: its words J3
investText: the loyalty each building buys near a vassal, with vassals
